summary: Frontend-only regression testing of the SIGNAL RE-ARMING BUG FIX in SinaisTab.jsx. Verified end-to-end that after both WIN and LOSS resolutions, a new signal correctly forms when a fresh 2+ streak appears at the end of the giros sequence. The reported user bug ('after one signal forms and 3 attempts pass, it's NOT forming another one after') is FIXED. All 3 flows plus scoreboard/clear checks PASS.

Click 2 (in signal) → WIN counter 0→1, signal cleared to 'Aguardando sequência...'. Click 25(Alto) → no new signal (streak=1). Click 30(Alto) → NEW signal fires target=BAIXO, dom=black, numbers=[2,4,6,8,10,11] again. CORE BUG FIX CONFIRMED.

tests_executed.steps_and_observations: Scoreboard started WIN:0 LOSS:0 → after FLOW 1 WIN:1 LOSS:0 → after FLOW 2 LOSS WIN:1 LOSS:1 → after FLOW 3 WIN WIN:2 LOSS:1. Counters persisted across CLEAR (LIMPAR) as expected (state only, not sessionStorage).

rca of the issue: Root cause (as stated by main agent): the previous detectTrigger implementation checked for a category CHANGE at the end (lastCat !== prevCat). After a signal was resolved (WIN or LOSS), the state of giros still had the same trailing categories, so on the very next spin no category CHANGE was detected and no new signal formed. Fix: detectTrigger was rewritten to search for a STREAK of ≥2 same categories at the end and return the category before the streak. Combined with tryCreateSignal being invoked from both the WIN and LOSS branches of the effect, the system now re-arms correctly on the very next qualifying spin. Reproduction and verification steps documented in FLOW 1 / FLOW 2 / FLOW 3 above.
